title: Strategic Account Intake: Opportunity Gravity Score and Commitment Windows
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: We receive a mix of inbound requests from strategic (ARR>250k) and mid-market customers that require engineering effort and roadmap commitments. Current intake is ad hoc: CS/AMs ping PMs and engs, escalations get fast-tracked without a consistent score, and we over-commit or delay promised rollouts. Goal: define an operational scoring system (Opportunity Gravity Score) plus clearly defined Commitment Windows (decision SLA + commitment class) so that top accounts get predictable responses and the product/org can make measurable trade-offs between revenue risk and delivery cost.
acceptance_criteria: Define a reproducible Opportunity Gravity Score formula that combines ARR exposure, renewal proximity, technical risk, strategic alignment, and escalations history
Produce a Commitment Window taxonomy (e.g., Immediate <30d, Near-term 30-90d, Watchlist 90-360d) and decision SLA per tier
Create intake form and CS/AM playbook that surfaces required artifacts (use case, expected traffic, security/compliance constraints, success metrics)
Implement a lightweight dashboard that shows live queue and score distribution for leadership review
Pilot the process with two enterprise customers and document outcomes, decisions, and any required product changes
tasks: Workshop scoring factors with CS/AM/RevOps and Engineering (owner: Marcelo)
Draft scoring algorithm and thresholds (owner: PM team)
Design intake form + fields in HubSpot/Confluence and integration to Jira (owner: Solutions Eng)
Create Commitment Window definitions and legal/finance checklist for revenue commitments (owner: Legal)
Build dashboard query in Looker / metrics for backlog & outcomes (owner: Analytics)
Run two customer pilots and collect feedback; iterate on thresholds (owner: PM)
Document final playbook and train CS/AMs (owner: Enablement)
comments: 2026-02-16 - Aisha Patel: Initial intake after leadership asks for a formalized path to reduce unpredictable escalations. Goal is not to say yes/no but to create predictable engagement bandwidth and decision SLAs.

2026-02-20 - Marcelo Ruiz: Ran 60-minute workshop with CS, AM, RevOps, and Eng. Key takeaways: renewal date and ARR weight must be normalized; some customers require security review gating; engineering wants a binary 'must-fix' flag for production incidents separate from roadmap intake.

2026-02-27 - Design feedback (Lina Ho): Proposed intake form needs to capture expected token volume and desired latency SLOs. Shared low-fidelity mock in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Opportunity+Intake+Mock

2026-03-03 - Analytics (Evan Zhang): Built a prototype Looker tile that shows 90-day window of inbound tickets with simulated gravity scores. Link: https://looker.redwood.ai/dashboards/strategic-intake-proto
2026-03-05 - Legal (Priya Menon): Commitment Windows that imply contractual SLAs will require Finance sign-off for revenue exposure >$500k. Recommend adding a 'Rev Exposure' field to the intake form.

2026-03-08 - Marcelo Ruiz: Drafted scoring formula and threshold examples. Sharing here for review: Gravity = 0.4*ARR_norm + 0.25*renewal_urgency + 0.15*security_risk + 0.1*strategic_alignment + 0.1*escalation_history. Open question: how to normalize ARR across segments to avoid favoring large but low-strategic-value accounts.

2026-03-10 - Aisha Patel: Sync scheduled with Head of Sales on 2026-03-15 to align thresholds with Q2 renewals. Next actions: finalize intake prototype, instrument Looker dashboard for leadership, and scope two pilot customers (one renews this quarter, one long-term strategic).
